evidence.snippet: To address this gap, we introduce MedGym, a benchmark environment for dynamic treatment recommendation.

claire_radar.motivation: Medical treatment recommendation poses several challenges to reinforcement learning (RL): patient physiology evolves in continuous time, measurements and interventions are performed at irregular intervals, and treatment effects vary substantially across individuals.
claire_radar.name: MedGym
claire_radar.oneLine: Provides a continuous-time reinforcement learning environment for dynamic medical treatment recommendation, built from clinical data with physics-informed neural networks. Supports offline and online RL with configurable parameters.
claire_radar.paperTitle: MedGym:A Unified Continuous-Time Benchmark for Dynamic Medical Treatment Reinforcement Learning

source.title: MedGym:A Unified Continuous-Time Benchmark for Dynamic Medical Treatment Reinforcement Learning

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Offers a realistic testbed for RL methods in continuous-time medical settings, enabling evaluation of personalization, safety, and online deployment gaps. Standardizes comparisons between discrete and continuous time approaches.
